name: S5 — a change above the reader does not move the line they are reading
why: A turn keeps writing while the operator reads back through it. When a step above them grows — a tool call lands, a card gains a line — everything below it shifts down, and the line they were on walks away. The old chat re-renders the whole conversation and has nothing to hold that line with; the new one captures the first visible block and puts it back.
